messages:
elaine (partnerships): Heads-up: we're proposing a small but important change for marketplace + hardware partners: require an optional `client_sdk_manifest` field submitted once per adapter startup. helps us map capabilities to kernel selections and allow optimized routing. want quick alignment on privacy, cert, and partner rollout.

sam (eng-platform): That seems useful. What's the manifest shape? and is it synchronous on every request or cached?

elaine (partnerships): Proposal (high level): POST /adapter/manifest on startup, payload: {\"adapter_id\": string, \"sdk_name\": string, \"sdk_version\": string, \"hardware_caps\": [string], \"flags\": {}}. We'll store it for 7 days and use it for routing & telemetry. Not required per-request.

rapha (eng-sdks): SDK teams will need a clear contract. if we accept arbitrary flags we risk fragmentation. recommend a small enumerated capability list (e.g., avx2, fp16-quant, streaming, kv-cache) + a freeform `notes` field for partner use.

viv (partner-eng): Partners will want control over when/what is sent. some SI customers are strict on metadata. we should offer an opt-out and an on-demand consent URL for customers to allow sending manifests.

meera (product): From product POV we want this to enable cost-tier routing and optimized kernels. success criteria: manifest coverage for 80% of active adapters within 6 weeks of announce; no latency regressions; privacy-approved text.

allen (legal): Privacy check: storing hardware identifiers could be sensitive if it contains serials or config that maps to customer identity. manifest must be schema-limited and scrub any PII. also add a contractual notice to marketplace T&Cs.

rapha (eng-sdks): We'll ship SDK helpers to build the manifest and validate schema. plan: SDK minor bump (3.5.x) with helper `buildManifest()` and an opt-in default disabled flag. partners can enable via env var.

sam (eng-platform): For certification: create a nightly CI job that calls POST /adapter/manifest and validates schema + rate-limiting. CI will also check that enabling manifest doesn't change request latencies > 2%.

ci-bot: New pipeline: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/adapter-manifest-34901 created. nightly runs scheduled. artifacts -> /artifacts/adapter-manifest/34901.

viv (partner-eng): I'll ping top 12 partners tomorrow with a preview package (manifest schema + SDK helpers + opt-out docs). want to offer a 4-week preview window before soft-enforcement.

elaine (partnerships): Proposed timeline: preview announced Mon (4w), soft-warning (8w), requirement for new marketplace listings (16w). existing listings get a 24w runway and opt-out process documented.

allen (legal): We'll draft the marketplace addendum and opt-out flow. Need product to confirm enforcement semantics so we can write clear customer-facing language.

meera (product): We'll expose a listing badge: "Adapter Manifest: registered / missing / opt-out". Product will integrate CI artifact status to drive that badge.

rapha (eng-sdks): Dev note: we'll include a compatibility shim that returns an empty manifest when not enabled and logs to local SDK logs. That reduces partner upgrade friction.

sam (eng-platform): Observability: add a privacy scrub pipeline on ingestion. drop any fields matching regexes for serials/emails. we'll publish the exact scrub rules in the RFC.

viv (partner-eng): One ask from partners: a test harness docker image and a local verifier that runs schema + latency checks. I'll ship that tonight.

ci-bot: Nightly runs scheduled starting 3490123900. Failures will file tickets in #partner-ci.

elaine (partnerships): Checklist:
- RFC + schema + preview package (elaine + rapha)
- SDK helpers & shim release (rapha)
- CI & manifest verifier (sam + ci-bot)
- Partner preview emails + harness (viv)
- Legal T&C addendum & opt-out flow (allen)
- Product badge & listing enforcement plan (meera)

elaine (partnerships): I'll assemble the announcement and ship the preview tomorrow EOD. Please flag any blockers here or ping me directly. :sparkles:
